plugins.description: Browser-side debug layer that exposes live PWA state (DOM, framework state, stores, events, library popups) to AI agents via MCP. Pairs with the optional chrome-devtools-mcp (registered separately); the bundled chrome-devtools-coexistence skill walks Claude through adding it.
